notes.title: Update V1.1.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with the coin counter not updating properly when entering a stage.
- Fixed a bug where pressing ESC repeatedly would not skip a cutscene.

notes.title: Update V1.1.0 - Extra Stage added!
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.1.0 has been released![/h1]
Hello, those of ye who Touhou Renkyouto! We've finally finished work on the long-awaited update for our game, finally bringing the promised Extra Stage to our game, alongside a few other things:

[h2]Extra Stage![/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45224777/66c908c278951940cbaf93a2b764a3d2e4b017da.png[/img]
A whole new stage, for those who thought that the Satori fight was easy and wanted more (shoutouts to that one Lithuanian guy). You'll be able to unlock it after completing Koishi's hide-and-seek game.

[h2]New character graphics![/h2]
Every single character has gone through a glow-up! There are too many to show in this post, so below is Parsee as an example:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45224777/427e5b9954b82325664530c897c5079295e11c44.png[/img]
[i]From old...[/i]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45224777/7432c7d763b310898cc1159e3743644f61c29656.png[/img]
[i]...to new.[/i]

[h2]Fixes to localization![/h2]
It turns out that there were many punctualization and capitalization errors in the text. Those have been fixed.

[h2]Bugfixes![/h2]
A bunch of them.

Thank you for your support of Touhou Renkyouto, and we hope that you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update V1.0.8
notes.notes:
- Dropped the money lost on Easy mode on a continue from half the money to 1/5 of the money.
- Fixed the dialogue between Daiyousei and Parsee on Stage 4.

notes.title: Update V1.0.7
notes.notes:
- Added a tutorial for the usage of active items. The tutorial comes up when you buy an active item at the store.
- Fixed cutscene dialogue carrying over to the next scene when skipping the scene.
- The bootup splash screen is now skippable like any other cutscene.
- Minor bugfixes.

notes.title: Update V1.0.6
notes.notes:
Behold, quality-of-life updates:

- Easy mode shouldn't crash now
- Yuugi's battle sprite was updated to the new one
- A music room has been added
- You can now skip cutscenes by pressing "Esc"
- "Esc" no longer pauses the game during cutscenes.

notes.title: Update V1.0.5
notes.notes:
We've just finished work on a new update for Touhou Renkyouto. Here's what's in 1.0.5:

- Rebalanced areas on certain levels to level out the difficulty.
- Improved Marisa's spells and non-spells to be a bit more difficult.
- More shortcuts added in Level 4.
- Almost all of the game's dialogue has been updated to make Parsee more like Parsee.
- Yuugi's dialogue sprite has been completely reworked.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224777/14e8a96f6a56dbc5a094a403cbf7150a2cb574f6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224777/65986c907fd7a545fa3dba6d8e6e83a848d45939.png[/img][/url]
- Various bugfixes.

We hope that you'll keep enjoying our game :)

notes.title: Release Day & Plans for future updates
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello to all you good fellows who have supported Touhou Renkyouto![/h1]

After more than a year of work, one half debugging and the other half rebugging, our game is ready to come out at last.

The main dev who has coded the game will have to be absent for a year when this game is published, so updates during that interim will be graphical ones. After that, we have plans to update the game to add an Extra Stage along with new NPCs for the pre-existing levels.

[i]The sprites for the upcoming characters are already done.[/i]

We hope that you all enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed developing it!
